name: King Lil G
description: [[King Lil G|Álex Gonzales]] (born July 30, 1986), known by his stage name [[King Lil G]], is a prominent Mexican-American rapper from [[Los Angeles County]]. He is widely recognized for his raw storytelling, capturing the struggles of street life, gang involvement, and his upbringing by a single mother. He fronts the AK47 Boyz movement and independent brand.
